name: Daily docs refresh
description: Keep the project documentation in sync on every weekday morning.

tasks.title: Refresh project documentation
tasks.description: Update the docs that drifted since the last run.
tasks.prompt:
Refresh this project's documentation.

Workspace contract (this task owns its own directory on disk):
- $SCHEDULED_TASK_DIR is the task root; $SCHEDULED_TASK_STATE_DIR is the durable state directory. Keep every long-lived cache, counter or note there (for example a state.json with the last documented commit) so the next run can continue instead of starting over.
- The current run has its own runs/<runId>/ directory with run.json, prompt.md, output.md, logs/ and tmp/. Use its tmp/ for scratch files; it is removed when the run finishes. The task-wide tmp/ is wiped at the start of every run, so never keep anything you need across runs there.
- Never write outside the task root and the project directory.

Steps:
1. Read $SCHEDULED_TASK_STATE_DIR/state.json if it exists and diff the project against the recorded commit/state.
2. Update the affected Markdown files, the README and any API docs.
3. Write the new state back to $SCHEDULED_TASK_STATE_DIR/state.json and finish with a short summary of what changed.
